## Goal

Turn any ordinary React or MDX source into an immutable, content-addressed version atomically, without the supervisor ever running artifact code.

## Owned requirements

Close each with the check below, through the real public interface (README §3).

| ID | Requirement | Route | Concrete check |
|---|---|---|---|
| AU-01 | An artifact is ordinary React/TypeScript, with MDX supported; no DSL, schema or closed component list is required | M, B | Fixture artifacts using plain React, TSX and MDX with no Mostra-specific constructs build, verify and render (WP-03 integration, browser) |
| AU-02 | A single TSX or MDX file is a complete artifact; a directory artifact supports pages, components, `"use server"` modules, data and assets | I, B | A single page.tsx, a single page.mdx and a directory with pages, components, "use server" modules, data and assets each publish and render |
| AU-03 | No per-artifact `package.json` or configuration is required to start | I | Fresh directory without package.json or config publishes (integration); no config file is written |
| AU-04 | Artifacts declare optional metadata (title, description, `family`, related artifacts) and a render `mode` defaulting to `spa` | M | Manifest metadata (title, description, family, links, mode) round-trips into artifact/get and results; mode defaults to spa (unit + integration) |
| AU-07 | The manifest is a literal `defineArtifact` in the entry (frontmatter in MDX), read statically; artifact identity comes from the manifest `id` or a path binding at first publish, and a duplicate claim is a publish error | M, I | Non-literal manifest gives MOSTRA_MANIFEST_NOT_LITERAL; supervisor-side extraction never executes code (spy); duplicate id claim fails publish |
| VR-01 | **Invariant.** Publish creates an immutable, content-addressed version whose identity covers source, lockfile, Mostra/kit versions, mode and build config; the output digest is recorded separately | M, I | Digest unit tests (byte changes, renames, lockfile, env fields change the ID; ignored paths don't); same pair publishes as reused |
| VR-02 | Publish is atomic; a failed publish leaves no visible version | I | Fault injection at each publish step leaves no visible version and cleans staging on next start |
| VR-11 | Version source snapshots live in the home, so versions, results and regression baselines don't depend on the authoring directory | I | Delete the authoring directory; artifact, versions, results and verify regression baselines remain readable |
| RT-02 | One supervisor and gateway hosts many artifacts; it never loads artifact code in-process | I | Process audit test: supervisor module graph contains no artifact module after build, publish, verify and action calls |

## Scope

From [WORK_PACKAGES.md](../WORK_PACKAGES.md):

- the builder child (Vite 8, React 19.3, MDX 3, Tailwind 4) behind the internal `RenderMode` (SPA);
- static manifest extraction;
- the `"use server"` client-stub transform (the registry of actions with dry-run flags);
- the `pages/` route registry;
- source snapshots and digests;
- the content-addressed version store;
- the atomic publish (not yet gated by `verify`, which WP-09 adds) and the `PublishReceipt`;
- source bindings and ID conflicts.

Design detail for this package:

- Manifest extraction with Oxc on the entry (literal only); MDX frontmatter.
- Builder child: Vite 8 with the SPA RenderMode, React 19.3, MDX 3, Tailwind 4; the `"use server"` transform emits client stubs and a registry of server functions (with `dryRun` references detected) for WP-08 and WP-09.
- Digests exactly as DATA_MODEL §2; source snapshot tarball in the home.
- Publish steps 1 to 7 of ARCHITECTURE §3 except the verify gate (step 4 added by WP-09); fault injection hooks for tests.
- `artifact/create`, `artifact/publish`, `artifact/list`, `artifact/get` protocol methods.

## Out of scope

- Dependency installs beyond the warm set (WP-04)
- Serving (WP-05)
- The verify gate (WP-09)

## Acceptance evidence

- single-file TSX and MDX and directory artifacts build with no configuration;
- identical source and environment publish to the same version (`reused`);
- a fault injected at every publish step leaves no visible version;
- a process audit shows the supervisor never loads artifact modules;
- versions stay readable after the source directory is deleted.

Also: `pnpm check` green, diff reviewed, the progress report's evidence table complete for every owned requirement (README §3), the evidence matrix regenerated, docs and AGENTS.md current, and the report finalized after acceptance (README §4).

## Risks and notes

- Build determinism: record `outputDigest`, never claim reproducibility (VR-01).

## Handoff

Published versions in the store, a builder registry other packages read, and receipts hosts rely on.
